instruction.name: vftintrne.w.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in `a` to signed 32-bit integer, rounding towards nearest even.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vftintrne.w.s $vr0, $vr8; vftintrne.w.s $vr1, $vr9; vftintrne.w.s $vr2, $vr10; vftintrne.w.s $vr3, $vr11; vftintrne.w.s $vr4, $vr12; vftintrne.w.s $vr5, $vr13; vftintrne.w.s $vr6, $vr14; vftintrne.w.s $vr7, $vr15
